description: Figure 4.1, the first of five plots, illustrates the Word Error Rate (WER) during fine-tuning of the Whisper model for the “tiny” variant, comparing different weight quantization and adaptation strategies over six training epochs. The x-axis, labeled “epoch,” ranges from 0 to 6 with integer tick marks, while the y-axis, labeled “WER,” spans from 25 to 70 with major gridlines at intervals of 5. Five distinct lines are plotted: “tiny AdaLoRA_int4” (gray solid line with square markers) starts at approximately 68.5 and decreases to 40.5; “tiny AdaLoRA_int8” (gray dashed line with square markers) begins at 60 and ends at 37; “tiny int4” (gray solid line with triangle markers) starts at 68.5 and declines to 32.5; “tiny int8” (gray dashed line with triangle markers) begins at 60 and ends at 36; and “tiny full” (gray dotted line with triangle markers) starts at 29 and gradually decreases to 23.5. All lines show a general downward trend in WER over epochs, with the “tiny full” configuration consistently achieving the lowest WER throughout training.
